senses.gloss: (denom. of מַלְגֵּז) to stack with the pitchfork.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:10">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:10">X</cite>), 10 <he>שנים … ולוֹגְזִין</he> if two take hold of a pitchfork and stack; <cite ref="Shabbat 92b">Sabb. 92ᵇ</cite>; Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, ch. IX, Par. 7.
